component.name: KheetSheet
component.summary: Keyboard shortcut overlay for the app you're currently using

description.p: KheetSheet shows a full-screen overlay of the active application's keyboard shortcuts, read live from its menus via AT-SPI, whenever you press a global shortcut.

screenshot.caption: Overlay showing Konsole's real shortcuts, grouped by menu

description.p: Added localisation support — KheetSheet's own UI text now follows the user's language settings, rather than always showing in English.
Replaced the blanket session-bus socket permission with named D-Bus grants (own-name for the daemon's own service, talk-name for KWin only) — no functional change, smaller sandbox footprint.
